# Selected ECC v1.10.0 vendor snapshot

This directory contains a curated subset of skills from [everything-claude-code v1.10.0](https://github.com/affaan-m/everything-claude-code/tree/v1.10.0) that are adapted for use in this repository.

Only the skills actively referenced by `.agents/skills/` overlays are included. The full upstream skill catalog is much larger.

See `docs/reference/ai-agent-upstream-sources.md` for provenance details.
